t: Water-resistant, rechargeable work light with aluminium alloy body. COB light delivers 600 lumens, while top flashlight provides 220 lumens of light. Red COB light is suitable for distress signalling or roadside emergencies. Battery run time is dependent on what light mode is selected, high provides 2.5 hours, while low offers 14.5 hours. Hands-free light options provided by steel clip and magnetic base.
